metadata.title: Trusted Cloud

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for operating cloud services in a manner that preserves security, governance, and risk control across IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, and multi-cloud environments.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Public and private cloud services including infrastructure, application platforms, software services, identity systems, and governance layers.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite pattern asserting that foundational, operational, and governance trust requirements for cloud environments are satisfied.

props.name: attack-tactic

props.name: attack-technique

props.name: defense-technique

props.name: defense-technique

props.name: defense-technique

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced for cloud security and privacy risk considerations, including loss of control, shared tenancy, control-plane exposure, and third-party dependency. Trusted Cloud patterns operationalize these risks through explicit governance and assurance mechanisms.

metadata.remarks: Trusted Cloud is a composite pattern asserting that foundational infrastructure trust, identity governance, networking controls, configuration posture, monitoring, third-party access governance, and cross-cloud policy consistency are collectively satisfied. It introduces no independent controls and exists solely as an aggregate trust claim for use in solution patterns and system security and privacy plans.
